description: This file is a test class for the EmployeeService component in the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of EmployeeService methods such as retrieving DAOs and related services, subordinate and supervisor ID listings, and email uniqueness checks.

classes.name: EmployeeServiceTest
classes.description: A unit test class extending TestCase to verify EmployeeService functionalities in various scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes an EmployeeService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDao
methods.description: Tests that EmployeeService returns an instance of EmployeeDao.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEventService
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of EmployeeEventService from EmployeeService.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTerminationService
methods.description: Checks that EmployeeTerminationService is correctly provided by EmployeeService.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Tests retrieving subordinate ID list with various includeChain parameter values.

methods.name: testIsSupervisor
methods.description: Verifies that isSupervisor correctly delegates to EmployeeDao.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployees
methods.description: Checks deletion of employees and return count.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Tests retrieving supervisor IDs with different includeChain parameters.

methods.name: testIsUniqueEmail
methods.description: Verifies email uniqueness checks against fixture data, testing multiple scenarios including null and existing emails.
